eir.0154 = {
	type = character_event
	title = eir.0154.t
	desc = eir.0154.desc
	theme = diplomacy
	left_portrait = {
		character = scope:eir_celtic_neighbour
		animation = personality_honorable
	}

	trigger = {
		eir_is_irish_ruler_trigger = yes
		is_ai = no
		has_global_variable = eir_done_brotherhood
		any_ruler = {
		is_ai = yes
		is_ruler = yes
		culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_brythonic }
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_ruler = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				is_ruler = yes
				culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_brythonic }
			}
			save_scope_as = eir_celtic_neighbour
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0154.a
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_gwynedd_alliance_modifier years = 12 }
		scope:eir_celtic_neighbour = { add_opinion = { target = root modifier = eir_gwynedd_friend_opinion opinion = 30 } }
		add_prestige = 100
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0154.b
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_celtic_brotherhood_modifier years = 6 }
		add_prestige = 50
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0154.c

}

		add_prestige = 50
		primary_heir ?= { add_opinion = { target = root modifier = eir_hospitality_opinion opinion = 20 } }
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0167.c
		add_piety = 50
		eir_vassal_opinion_effect = { MODIFIER = eir_oath_sworn_opinion OPINION = 3 }
		ai_chance = { base = 20 }
	}
}
